name: Weather (script)
author: WinDock
description: Current conditions and a forecast popup from Open-Meteo, with optional daily forecasts on the dock in several layouts and two icon packs. Choose a place for each widget or use the app's default place.

settings.label: Place
settings.description: The town or city whose weather is shown. Empty: the app's default place.

settings.label: Name on the dock
settings.description: Shown under the temperature (empty: none).

settings.label: Units
settings.description: Metric shows °C and km/h, imperial °F and mph. Default: metric.

settings.label: Refresh every
settings.description: How often a new forecast is fetched. Default: 30.

settings.label: Forecast on the dock

choices.label: Today's high and low (under the temperature)

settings.description: Several days: a cell per day after the current conditions, laid out by Layout below; the slot grows.

settings.label: Days on the dock
settings.description: How many days the forecast on the dock shows. Default: 3.

settings.label: Layout
settings.description: A preset for the current conditions and the day cells, or Custom for the fields below. Default: automatic.

choices.label: Strip: a column per day beside the conditions
Tiles: day over icon, high and low beside them
List: a line per day under the conditions
Card: big conditions, tiles under them

settings.label: Current conditions
settings.description: The icon beside the temperature, or above it. Automatic: beside on a top or bottom dock, above on a left or right dock.

settings.label: Each day
settings.description: What a day's cell looks like. Automatic: a column on a top or bottom dock, a line on a left or right dock.

choices.label: A column: day, icon, high, low
A tile: day over the icon, high over the low beside them

settings.label: The days go
settings.description: Where the day cells go: after the current conditions or under them. Automatic: after on a top or bottom dock, under on a left or right dock.

settings.label: Show the condition's name
settings.description: Writes the condition ("Partly cloudy") under the temperature. Off by default.

settings.label: Show the place under the temperature
settings.description: Writes the place's name under the temperature. Off by default.

settings.label: Show today's high
settings.description: Adds today's highest temperature under the current one. Off by default.

settings.label: Show today's low
settings.description: Adds today's lowest temperature under the current one. Off by default.

settings.label: Day names
settings.description: How the days are named: Mon, M or Monday. Automatic: Mon in columns and tiles, M in lines.

settings.label: Call the first day "Today"
settings.description: The first day cell says Today instead of its weekday. On by default.

settings.label: High and low
settings.description: How a high and low pair is written on one line. Automatic: arrows under the temperature, a slash in a day cell.

settings.label: Icons
settings.description: The pictures of the conditions: WinDock's filled glyphs, or Lucide's line icons (lucide.dev, ISC licence). Default: WinDock.

settings.label: Icon colours
settings.description: Coloured: a yellow sun and blue rain. Single colour: everything in the text colour (the WinDock pack keeps its yellow sun). Default: coloured.

settings.label: Size
settings.description: Scales the whole slot on a dock (a desktop widget fills its window instead). Default: 100.

settings.label: Compact (the icon only)
settings.description: The temperature and the text lines are left out; the popup still shows everything.

settings.label: Clicking the widget opens
settings.description: What a click does: open the forecast popup, open the widget's settings to choose the place, or nothing. Default: the forecast popup.

settings.label: Days in the popup
settings.description: How many days the popup's daily forecast lists. Default: 7.

settings.label: Hours in the popup's strip
settings.description: How many hours the popup's hourly strip covers. Default: 24.
